name: guardify
description: Consent-first safety coordination PWA and API

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend run audit && npm --prefix frontend run audit
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit
